name: Security CSD Link 12
definition: Defines how the CSD is linked to the security.

SecurityMaintenance.name: Security Maintenance
SecurityMaintenance.definition: Specifies if the involved CSD (issuer/technical issuer/investor) is also the maintainer of related reference data.

IssuanceAccount.name: Issuance Account
IssuanceAccount.definition: Account to or from which a securities entry is made.

DefaultLink.name: Default Link
DefaultLink.definition: Specifies whether the security CSD link is the default link. |Usage: when DefaultLink is absent, value is No/false

ValidFrom.name: Valid From
ValidFrom.definition: Defines the date since when the CSD is linked to the security.

ValidTo.name: Valid To
ValidTo.definition: Defines the date until when the CSD is linked to the security.
